progression_strategy.text: Energy refreshes are the highest-value crystal spend: take all 3 daily 50-crystal Normal/Fleet refreshes; add the 3 daily 100-crystal Cantina refreshes when speed matters. Grab the 3x daily free bonus energy and never let energy cap.
Conquest 'red crate' farming is the single biggest cost/time saver in the game — clear hard mode early each Conquest, then datacron-farm the rest. Prioritize a strong Conquest team.

Farm cost-efficiency order (cheapest first): Conquest units, then Normal/Fleet accelerated nodes, then unaccelerated, then Cantina, then Proving Grounds (most expensive). Prefer the cheaper source when a unit is farmable in more than one place.
Spread farming across multiple characters instead of resetting single nodes — single-node refreshes cascade in cost. Farm mods from the final tier of Mod Battles for slicing materials.
Don't over-farm character shards while neglecting gear and relic materials — a wide roster with no gear can't compete. Balance shard energy with gear/relic-mat farming.

At mid-to-late game (~5-7M+ GP) the flywheel is Galactic Legends: each GL wins GAC, TW and arena at once, which raises crystal + Kyber income, which gears the next GL faster. Progressing your closest GL is usually the single highest-ROI investment.

Fleet progression path: build the Endurance (Galactic Republic) fleet, add the GR Marauder (needs Bad Batch), move into Negotiator, and farm Bounty Hunter ships (Hound's Tooth first) toward the Executor capital ship — a top fleet-arena and GAC goal.
SWGOH rewards patience: steady daily roster expansion without crystal refreshes beats dumping crystals, except to hit a time-limited event or Galactic Legend gate.

game_mechanics.text: SWGOH now runs on two parallel progression tracks: the CLASSIC track (gear + Relics, used by Galactic Legends and Conquest units — unchanged) and the newer ERA track (Era Levels). Think of them as a two-game system: classic = your GL push; Era = a resource engine that feeds it.

ERA Levels (EL) are a separate progression axis: Era units gain power from Era Levels instead of classic gear/Relics (40 free Era Levels exist). At the end of an Era a unit's Era Level converts into PERMANENT level/gear/Relic/ability on that character (it becomes a keepable 'Legacy' unit) — so Era leveling is not lost. NOTE: CG has NOT published the exact Era-Level-to-gear/relic table; specific figures circulating (e.g. EL 135 -> Relic 8, EL 65 -> Gear 12) are unconfirmed player estimates, not official.

COLISEUM is the new daily Era game mode (unlocks at player level 10). Bosses rotate daily; your score is a high-water mark per boss per day (beat your best once and you're done that day — low time cost). ONLY Era units can play it. Rewards = one-time score-milestone rewards (reset each Era) + a daily leaderboard, which is a PRIMARY source of the new Relic 10 materials.

LOANED UNITS are free Era units the game gives all players for the current Era (they expire at Era end, usable only in Era modes). They share one Era Level, upgraded automatically by 'Loaned Unit Era Level Increase' tokens — so you can play Coliseum/Era modes even without owning Era characters.

Era Materials (to raise Era Levels) come from Coliseum, Era Marquee events, Era Journey events, the Episode Track, or the store. Era currency inflow was increased 200%+ to speed Relic growth for everyone.

SHOULD YOU UPGRADE ERA UNITS? Directionally yes — a unit's Era Level converts to permanent gear/Relic on it at Era end, so leveling pre-loads permanent progression on units you keep. IMPORTANT: CG has NOT published the exact conversion rates (the community's formal rate-clarity request went unanswered), so the payoff cannot be quantified — do not cite specific numbers as fact. REASONING (not sourced): prioritize Era units you'll want long-term and that push higher-reward Coliseum tiers; for the current New Republic era the community builds Coliseum around Captain Carson Teva (leader) + Colonel Ward + Rotta + Zeb.

END-OF-ERA CONVERSION (OFFICIAL, CG_Meathead): leftover Era Materials AND Era Leveling Currency both convert into Era Currency (Era Currency itself — used for LSTs / R10 salvage — carries over, not downgraded). The exact conversion RATE was NOT published despite repeated community requests. A community claim that they convert to 'credits' is outdated/wrong per the dev post. REASONING (not sourced): since spent Era Levels become permanent gear/relic on a unit while unspent materials become generic Era Currency, spending on a unit you'll keep is directionally better than hoarding — but this can't be quantified from published data.

HOW ERA SUPPLEMENTS THE GL PUSH: GLs and Conquest units still need classic gear/Relic (GL prep is unchanged), but Era eases the bottlenecks that fuel it — the Episode Track free track now hands out Relic 1-5 mats + Signal Data, Coliseum feeds Relic 10 mats, and Era Lightspeed Tokens fast-track classic GL-prereq squads instead of hand-farming. Treat Coliseum + Episode Track as a quick DAILY resource harvest for your GL push.

LIGHTSPEED TOKENS (LSTs) instantly bring ONE eligible character to Level 85 plus a star/relic/ability level set by the token's TIER: Carbonite=3star Gear XII, Bronzium=4star Relic 1, Chromium=5star Relic 3, Aurodium=6star Relic 5, Kyber=7star Relic 6 (ability level equals the tier's rank; order weakest-to-strongest is Carbonite < Bronzium < Chromium < Aurodium < Kyber). They do NOT grant Zetas or Omicrons — you unlock those yourself.

LST SCOPE + ELIGIBILITY: each token has a scope — 'Any Character' OR a specific faction (e.g. Separatist, Smuggler) — set per-token and INDEPENDENT of tier (a Kyber can be Any-Character OR faction-locked). The eligible-character list is fixed when the token is released and is NEVER updated for later units. LSTs CANNOT be applied to Galactic Legends, Conquest-exclusive units, Journey/Legendary characters, or Capital Ships, and only work on Legacy-Era units (released before ~Nov 2024). 'Any Character' therefore means any ELIGIBLE unit, not literally every unit.

LST usage rules: tokens EXPIRE 6 months after you acquire them — spend expiring ones first. If a unit already exceeds the token's tier the token is wasted, so never apply one to a unit already at/above its star+relic; instead it can be dismantled for crafting materials.

WHICH LST TO SPEND (decision logic): among the units the token can legally hit (matching its scope, Legacy-Era, not a GL/Conquest/Journey unit or capital ship, and currently BELOW the token's star/relic), pick the one that best serves the player's goals — a Galactic Legend PREREQUISITE they still need, or a key meta-team member — and that gains the most (furthest below the token's tier). Break ties by soonest expiration.

SWGOH wallet currencies (canonical names): Credits (character upgrades), Ship Building Materials (ship upgrades), Crystals (premium), Ally Points, Cantina Battle Tokens, Squad Arena Tokens, Fleet Arena Tokens, Galactic War Tokens, Guild Tokens, Championship Tokens (Grand Arena/GAC), Mk I/II/III Raid Tokens (Guild Store, from Raids), Mk I/II/III Guild Event Tokens (Guild Events Store, from raids/TB/TW), Conquest Credits, Episode Currency (Episode Track), Era Currency (Era game modes), Legend Tokens (GL events), Data-caches (Datacrons), Shard Currency (Shard Shop).

acceleration_tips.text: Seed entry — the weekly refresh (and any videos you feed with `--add-video`) will fill this with concrete, high-value tips that accelerate progression.
**Jotaz Strategy**: Avoid excessively buffing your team when facing the Jotaz boss, as its "Backhand Sweep" dispels buffs and increases Jotaz's Offense for each buff removed.
Use Teva's basic ability, "On Your Signal," to trigger counterattacks (up to 2x per turn) and grant Retribution to all New Republic allies on his turn, boosting team damage.

His special ability, "Keeping the Peace," hits three times, calls an ally to assist, and applies Offense Down, Defense Down, and Speed Down on critical hits. Use this to set up assists and apply crucial debuffs.

Teva's unique ability, "Unauthorized Operation," grants him significant Max Health, Protection, and Offense, helping him survive longer and deal more damage. It also applies Crit Chance/Potency Down to all enemies when a New Republic ally is inflicted with a debuff and reduces enemy speed if they are faster than Teva, providing valuable speed control.

At higher Era Levels (e.g., 80 and above), Teva is an excellent leader for New Republic teams. An effective lineup against Jotaz includes Teva (Leader), Colonel Ward, Zeb Orrelios, R5-D4, and Captain Drogan to maximize damage.

Prioritize reaching Era Level 80 for Teva. This unlocks his Unique T6 (+15% Max Offense) and Leader T6 (NR allies gain Retribution when using a Special), dramatically boosting his effectiveness as a leader by amplifying counterattack damage and team-wide retribution.
If your account is below Era Level 80, Teva's leader ability might underperform against Jotaz compared to other leaders.

Consider using Embo as your leader (e.g., with Cad Bane, Teva, Colonel Ward, Captain Drogan) for better results against Jotaz in Tier 8. Embo's assists can lead to faster contract payouts and higher damage.
Even if not leading, Teva can be valuable in other teams (like Embo-led Bounty Hunter teams) due to his assist-calling special, which helps trigger Bounty Hunter payouts more frequently.

**Team Composition for Embo (Lower Era Level)**: A strong Embo-led team against Jotaz for lower-level accounts can include Embo (Leader), Cad Bane, Captain Carson Teva (not leading), Colonel Ward, and Captain Drogan.

farming_priorities.text: Relic materials (aeromagnifiers, carbonite circuits, bonded databases) are the deepest bottleneck for finishing any Galactic Legend requirement roster — prioritize relic-material stores and hard-node energy over new-character shards once a GL prereq is 7 stars.

gear_relic_guidance.text: For GL prerequisites, hitting 7 stars is the gate; relic level is the second gate. A unit at the target relic but below 7 stars still does not count — star it first, then relic.
